The '''funeral of Shmi Skywalker Lars''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After his mother, [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]], was kidnapped by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|raided]] a Tusken [[Valley of the Spirits|camp]] in an attempt to find her, but arrived too late to prevent her [[Death/Legends|death]]. The funeral took place soon after at the [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] Skywalker Lars has shared with her husband, [[Cliegg Lars/Legends|Cliegg Lars]]. It was attended by Cliegg and [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Whitesun]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and Skywalker, who wrapped and carried her body to the gravesite.

Owen Lars later removed the headstones.
